searchText: I wonder how reliable that would be in Kurtosis. In Prysm we have a Beacon API evaluator in our end-to-end tests that compares results from many API calls between Prysm and Lighthouse, and it's very flaky at the moment. I can share details if you're interested, but the main issue is that results that should be deterministic sometimes aren't (all endpoints that we consider non-deterministic are only checked for a 200 response) Having something like this would be extremely valuable but might be very hard to pull off, especially if we want to compare responses between all clients made an assertoor test, but due to the high number of random EIP fields in the dev branch in consensus spec, its gonna be very hard to get it working I wonder if we could have a feature branch of the consensus spec repo, and have a more mainstream dev branch for only the absolutely latest spec? cc <@592004585506340885> beacon API tests arent in the consesnsus spec tho? no what am i missing?

excerpts.author: radekkapka
excerpts.content: I wonder how reliable that would be in Kurtosis. In Prysm we have a Beacon API evaluator in our end-to-end tests that compares results from many API calls between Prysm and Lighthouse, and it's very flaky at the moment. I can share details if you're interested, but the main issue is that results that should be deterministic sometimes aren't (all endpoints that we consider non-deterministic are only checked for a 200 response)
